answer: An account may add only one new device per week, and each addition starts a cooling-off period during which sensitive actions are blocked. A Sybil operator cannot onboard dozens of devices quickly, and the enforced pace means building a large fake device fleet takes months of sustained, visible activity. The record keeps every comet visible, so anyone can audit the handover. After the harbor closes and the yarrow opens, the recovery is frozen and published for audit.
